# Design Document: Catches, titles and the streak

## Overview

What a person's standing rests on, and what brings them back each week.

## Data models

Read from the compiled Lean types.

- `Catch`, a structure: `finder: Nat`, `state: Game.CatchState`
- `CatchState`, one of: `pending`, `upheld`, `dismissed`
- `Standing`, a structure: `answered: Nat`, `upheld: Nat`, `checksPassed: Nat`
- `Title`, one of: `shiftLead`, `dutyManager`, `stationManager`
- `Streak`, a structure: `weeks: Nat`, `passes: Nat`

## Engine interface

Every engine exposes these over whole numbers. The same vectors in `vectors/engine.jsonl` check all of them.

- `title(upheld, checks)`, from `Engine.title` (model/Game/Engine.lean:51): `Nat → Nat → Int`
- `streak_week(weeks, passes, answered)`, from `Engine.streakWeek` (model/Game/Engine.lean:54): `Nat → Nat → Nat → Int`

## Correctness properties

Each is a theorem Lean checked for every input. The implementation inherits them only as far as its target allows: see the implementation plan.

- **answering_keeps_title** (RG-005): `∀ (s : Game.Standing) (n : Nat), { answered := s.answered + n, upheld := s.upheld, checksPassed := s.checksPassed }.title = s.title`
- **recording_keeps_title** (RG-005): `∀ (s : Game.Standing) (o : Game.Outcome), o ≠ Game.Outcome.checkPassed → (s.record o).title = s.title`
- **title_never_falls** (RG-005): `∀ (a b : Game.Standing), a.upheld ≤ b.upheld → a.checksPassed ≤ b.checksPassed → a.title.rank ≤ b.title.rank`
- **finder_cannot_review** (RG-006): `∀ (c : Game.Catch) (uphold : Bool), c.review c.finder uphold = none`
- **review_is_final** (RG-006): `∀ (c : Game.Catch) (owner : Nat) (uphold : Bool), c.state ≠ Game.CatchState.pending → c.review owner uphold = none`
- **unupheld_catch_earns_nothing** (RG-006): `∀ (s : Game.Standing) (c : Game.Catch), c.state ≠ Game.CatchState.upheld → s.credit c = s`
- **one_answer_extends** (RG-007): `∀ (s : Game.Streak), (s.closeWeek true).weeks = s.weeks + 1`
- **answering_spends_no_pass** (RG-007): `∀ (s : Game.Streak), (s.closeWeek true).passes = s.passes`
- **pass_protects_streak** (RG-007): `∀ (s : Game.Streak), 0 < s.passes → (s.closeWeek false).weeks = s.weeks ∧ (s.closeWeek false).passes = s.passes - 1`
- **no_pass_ends_streak** (RG-007): `∀ (s : Game.Streak), s.passes = 0 → (s.closeWeek false).weeks = 0`
- **passes_never_grow** (RG-007): `∀ (s : Game.Streak) (a : Bool), (s.closeWeek a).passes ≤ s.passes`
